    # Defensive defaults
    center = observation.get("position", (0, 0))
    target = observation.get("target", None)
    alive = observation.get("alive", True)
    # If there is a known enemy or threat, try to move away from it
    nx, ny = center
    if isinstance(target, tuple) and len(target) == 2:
        tx, ty = target
        dx = nx - tx
        dy = ny - ty
        # normalize to -1,0,1
        if dx == 0:
            dx_step = 0
        else:
            dx_step = 1 if dx > 0 else -1
        if dy == 0:
            dy_step = 0
        else:
            dy_step = 1 if dy > 0 else -1
        # move away if possible
        if -1 <= dx_step <= 1 and -1 <= dy_step <= 1:
            return [dx_step, dy_step]

    # If there's a resource nearby, try to move toward it
    resource = observation.get("resource", None)
    if isinstance(resource, tuple) and len(resource) == 2:
        rx, ry = resource
        dx = rx - nx
        dy = ry - ny
        if dx != 0 or dy != 0:
            dx_step = 1 if dx > 0 else -1 if dx < 0 else 0
            dy_step = 1 if dy > 0 else -1 if dy < 0 else 0
            return [dx_step, dy_step]

    # Territory control heuristic: move toward the center area if specified
    goal_area = observation.get("goal_area", None)
    if isinstance(goal_area, tuple) and len(goal_area) == 2:
        gx, gy = goal_area
        dx = gx - nx
        dy = gy - ny
        dx_step = 1 if dx > 0 else -1 if dx < 0 else 0
        dy_step = 1 if dy > 0 else -1 if dy < 0 else 0
        return [dx_step, dy_step]

    # Fallback: stay or slight exploration bias
    # If possible, try to move right, then down, else stay
    if (observation.get("can_move", True)):
        return [1, 0]

    return [0, 0]
